resources.title: Excel Skills for Business: Essentials by Macquarie University
SQLBolt - Learn SQL with simple interactive exercises

practice_tasks: Create an Excel spreadsheet using VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, and basic IF statements to analyze a dummy sales dataset.
Complete lessons 1 through 6 on SQLBolt covering SELECT queries, filtering, and joins.
Build Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts in Excel to summarize quarterly business performance.
Write intermediate SQL queries involving GROUP BY, HAVING, and JOINs using Mode's interactive editor.
Connect a sample CSV dataset to Tableau Public and build your first bar chart and line graph dashboard.
Study mean, median, standard deviation, and basic probability concepts; calculate them for a dataset in Excel.
Initialize a local Git repository, make commits, and push a project folder to GitHub.

resources.title: Google Cloud Machine Learning Crash Course

practice_tasks: Set up a free MongoDB Atlas cluster and insert/query JSON-based documents.
Complete module overviews on AWS core infrastructure (EC2, S3) and review a basic ETL pipeline architecture concept.
Complete the first 2 modules of Google's ML Crash Course to understand basic features and loss functions.
